summary: Adversarial regression tests found two false-pass risks in scripts/audit-gate.mjs. Running the gate outside the repository can audit a different lockfile. JSON.parse also accepts duplicate severity keys and can discard a nonzero high count. Twenty of twenty-two targeted tests passed; both failures reproduce the risks. The valid nonzero pnpm exit, stdout warning, and 12,000-advisory cases behaved fail-closed or matched counts.
blocking_findings: F1 [Major]: scripts/audit-gate.mjs:88 calls execFileSync without a repository-root cwd. tests/audit-gate.adversarial.test.ts:67-79 invokes the gate from another directory with a cwd-sensitive pnpm fixture. The fixture returns a clean report only at the repository root and high findings elsewhere; the gate exits 1 instead of the expected 0. A caller can therefore get an audit result for a different lockfile, including a false clean result. Pin cwd to the repository root derived from import.meta.url.

F2 [Major]: scripts/audit-gate.mjs:100-104 passes duplicate object keys through JSON.parse. tests/fixtures/audit-duplicate-count-keys.json contains high=3 followed by high=0 with no advisories; the gate exits 0 instead of exit 2 for ambiguous input. Reject duplicate keys before accepting vulnerability counts.

The implementation introduced in the phase is scripts/audit-gate.mjs.

Routing and strategy artifacts: the track plan records accepted Review B notes F6 and F7. Review B report review-b-cb16739.json records the live-cwd finding and timeout probes. No track-specific test-strategy.md or anti-pattern artifact exists. build-graph is installed, but graph.db is absent, so graph inspection was skipped.

Targeted command node_modules/.bin/vitest run --maxWorkers=1 tests/audit-gate*.test.ts: 2 test files, 22 tests; 20 passed and 2 failed. The failing cases are audits the repository lockfile when invoked from another working directory and rejects duplicate severity keys instead of accepting the last value.
Nonzero child case: valid high-severity JSON from a fixture pnpm that exits 1 gives gate exit 1 with critical=0 high=1.
Stdout warning case: a warning prefix before valid JSON gives exit 2 and audit unavailable; no vulnerability counts print.
Large count case: a valid document with 12,000 moderate advisories exits 0 and prints moderate=12000.
Timeout branch was not added to the suite because the production timeout is fixed at 120000 ms. Review B separately probed an 800 ms copy and confirmed exit 2 on timeout.

ratings.evidence: The cwd-sensitive test fails at tests/audit-gate.adversarial.test.ts:75 because scripts/audit-gate.mjs does not pin the repository cwd.
The targeted suite fails first on both cwd and duplicate-key probes, while the nonzero exit and 12,000-advisory cases pass.
The added code is confined to tests/audit-gate.adversarial.test.ts and one adversarial fixture; production code remains unchanged.
The exact targeted Vitest command reproduces both false-pass cases and the Prettier command passes on the new test files.
